label: A total holder of another that is not MOTION_3 held in the act by which it holds cannot be lacking
paraphrase: Conclusion: it is impossible that there be no f, x and r with f totally holding x in r and f not MOTION_3 held in r (definition ea1904bc-bdfa-4835-a4a7-8545c5221e2e). 'Not MOTION_3 held in r' also holds when f is not in act in r; the actualizer premise 40fc38ad-2cfe-4da6-8632-137fc5ff9188, not a premise here, excludes that case. Such an f may be held in other respects; MOTION_3 has no potency clause, so the conclusion is silent on whether f is in potency anywhere. Derived only with the open bridge that a held total holder is totally held; Control part 2 is an interpretation of the total-holding regress in which it fails.
